name: Mewtwo
title: Genetic Apex & Psychic Overlord
lore: Created by genetic engineering from the DNA of the mythical Pokémon Mew. Mewtwo commands unmatched telekinetic force, materializing destructive Shadow Balls, bending space-time to teleport at will, and detonating psychic shockwaves.

moves.name: Psychic Palm (5A)
moves.description: Snappy telekinetic palm strike with fast recovery. Ideal combo starter and poke.

moves.name: Psychic Crush (5B)
moves.description: Erects a telekinetic compression force field around the opponent, crushing defenses.

moves.name: Teleport Strike (5C)
moves.description: Bends space-time to vanish and slash forward with an energized psychic crest that wallbounces.

moves.name: Air Psychic Jab (8A)
moves.description: Mid-air telekinetic strike to intercept jumping opponents.

moves.name: Air Teleport Cleave (8C)
moves.description: Airborne downward psychic axe cleave driving opponents hard into the dirt.

moves.name: Shadow Ball (Special Projectile)
moves.description: Charges shadowy dark matter between palms and unleashes a homing high-velocity projectile.

moves.name: Psystrike (Super Art Finisher)
moves.description: Mewtwo's signature legendary psychic super art. Materializes waves of mental shockwaves erupting into an immense explosion.
